# LEGACY MIRROR — do not edit

This directory is an older snapshot of the phonics-fun-hub web app.

**The production web app is at the repo root** (`/src`, deployed by
`/vercel.json`). All feature work, bug fixes, and deploys happen there.

This folder is kept temporarily for reference only. It is not wired to
deployments and will not receive further updates. Plan to remove it once
we're confident nothing upstream depends on its paths.

If you're a reviewer: ignore everything in this directory and read the
root app instead.
